summary: Local-first archive and normalization service for messages recovered from iPhone backups, with append-only history and Agent OS JSONL exports. Agent OS is an optional client.
constraints: Never read or commit message content, backups or the data root.
Coverage claims are scoped to each source; backup success never implies all-time completeness.
current_priorities: Validate the foreground watch workflow on a trusted physical iPhone and confirm incremental backup behavior.
Add schema-generation fixtures and validate attributedBody decoding against real iOS samples.
Expand attachment metadata extraction and contact-card resolution.
next_action: Validate the foreground watch workflow on a trusted physical iPhone (needs the operator's phone).
waiting_on: Operator with the physical iPhone for the real-device watch test
